card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: Spaces, periods or single letters just before or inside a numbered section reference in drug-label headings and cross-references, such as 4.1, 5.7 or 8.4. Also seen before the second number in a dose range.

modes.label: Section number lists
modes.description: The gap or period right before the next number in a run of section references.

modes.label: Heading numbers
modes.description: The period or space inside a numbered section heading such as 4.1 or 5.1.

modes.label: Dose range gap
modes.description: The space before the upper number of a dose range.

card.plain: It fires on the small gaps and dots inside numbered section references, like 5.7, in drug labels.
